reviewGoal: Capture SQL review, migration direction, and operator approval fields before any Java rollback SQL can be considered.

requiredReviewFields.name: rollback-sql-review-owner
requiredReviewFields.description: Human owner responsible for reviewing rollback SQL artifacts.

requiredReviewFields.name: migration-direction
requiredReviewFields.description: Operator-selected migration direction for the rollback window.

requiredReviewFields.name: operator-approval-placeholder
requiredReviewFields.description: Placeholder that must be replaced by a real operator approval record outside this sample.

requiredReviewFields.name: rollback-sql-artifact-reference
requiredReviewFields.description: Reference to the reviewed SQL artifact or explicit no-op statement.

requiredReviewFields.name: production-database-access-boundary
requiredReviewFields.description: Confirms this sample does not connect to the production database.

forbiddenOperations: Executing rollback SQL from this sample
Connecting to a production database from this sample
Embedding production SQL text with secret values
